name: @ramen-suite/core
description: JSON model format and modeling kernel for the RAMEN suite

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts src/model/index.ts src/ramen/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outdir=dist --outbase=src --external:json-schema-library --external:short-unique-id
scripts.verify: npm run schema:check && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm run examples:check && npm test
scripts.examples:check: tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json --noEmit && node --experimental-strip-types examples/ramen-programmatic.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/ramen-interface.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/generic-model.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/ramen-annotations.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/ramen-basic.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/ramen-levels.ts && node --experimental-strip-types examples/export/edition.ts
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && node --experimental-strip-types --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='dist/**/*.js' --test test/**/*.test.ts
